g.title: Flow
g.text: Implemented checks, timing ownership and command lifetime

g.title: imu
g.text: Raw read time is not a sensor hardware trigger

g.title: snapshot
g.text: Finite / complete q and dq; source + receipt ages ≤ 100 ms
IMU / JointState stamp skew ≤ 20 ms in real-feedback mode

g.title: joints
g.text: JointState stamp preserves oldest included receive age

g.title: policy
g.text: Latest input only; no inference FIFO or catch-up bursts
Original observation / raw previous-action / action-scale semantics

g.title: post
g.text: Original snapshot still fresh; elapsed work ≤ 20 ms by default
Finite output; no fault / estop / shutdown
Expired result is discarded; policy fault latches

g.title: command
g.text: Training angle bounds + model Kp / Kd

g.title: bench
g.text: No hardware CAN / automatic enable in tracking launch

g.title: can
g.text: Per-joint monotonic deadline = earliest remaining lifetime
Fresh explicit enable + asynchronous healthy ACK required

g.title: map
g.text: Joint bounds; desired velocity / optional feedforward torque clamp
Preserve existing direction, offset and ankle mapping

g.title: tx
g.text: Nonblocking MIT frames; independent RX threads

g.title: motor
g.text: Position error and Kp / Kd generate actuator effort
Zero desired velocity / feedforward torque does not bound actual motion

g.title: lifetime
g.text: C++ relay and CAN retransmission never renew source time or expiry.
Invalid / stale control state and expired commands retain their disable behavior.
Limits and budgets shown here are configuration, not measured hardware guarantees.

g.title: supervisor
g.text: Explicit /safety/estop still stops the existing consumers
IMU input contract is external integration work

g.title: planned
g.text: New actual-speed / total-torque / tracking-error threshold checks
No claim of physical sample synchronization or verified Jetson throughput

g.title: old->can
g.text: Still subject to CAN backend gates
